## Pynapple fundamentals
```python
import pynapple as nap
```

- Time series
```python {.number-lines startFrom=2}
ts = nap.Ts(t=[1,2,3,4,5])
```

- Time series with data
```python {.number-lines startFrom=3}
ts = nap.Ts(t=[1,2,3,4,5], d=[0, 0, 0, 1, 1])
```
